main.description: Genesis record of a unique pointless thing on Give a Thing. Stored in the creator's repository (@giveathing.com for generated daily pulls, or the creator's PDS for custom collections).

name.description: Unique name of the pointless thing.

category.description: Macro-category of the thing (or custom collection name).

subcategory.description: Specific subcategory or aisle within the category/collection.

description.description: Evocative inspection description of the object.

flavorText.description: Short comedic RPG flavor quote or observation.

uselessTrait.description: A completely pointless RPG stat or quirk (e.g., '+0 Aerodynamics').

iconAlt.description: Accessible alt text describing the sprite.

createdBy.description: DID of the account that created this thing (@giveathing.com for generated pulls, or the collection creator's DID).

collectionId.description: Unique TID of the creator Mystery Box collection this thing belongs to (omitted for Daily Pull items).

collection.description: AT-URI backlink to the parent com.giveathing.collection record (omitted for Daily Pull items).

discoveredBy.description: DID of the player who discovered or unboxed this thing.

pullDate.description: UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD) when this thing was created or pulled.

updatedAt.description: Optional timestamp when the collection creator edited this thing's details.
